name: metrics
summary: The metrics in the Prometheus text format

response.body:
# HELP rdm_process_ready 1 when the process serves requests
# TYPE rdm_process_ready gauge
# HELP rdm_process_start_time_seconds When the process started
# TYPE rdm_process_start_time_seconds gauge
# HELP rdm_http_requests_total Requests answered, by method, route and status
# TYPE rdm_http_requests_total counter
# HELP rdm_http_request_duration_seconds Time to answer a request, by route
# TYPE rdm_http_request_duration_seconds histogram
# HELP rdm_database_unavailable_total Requests and background threads that got no database connection, by reason
# TYPE rdm_database_unavailable_total counter
# HELP rdm_database_pool_size DATABASE_POOL_SIZE
# TYPE rdm_database_pool_size gauge
...
